heuristic.rule: Tool with the most findings on TerraGoat

faults.title: Storage bucket has no default encryption
SSH is open to the whole internet
Remote desktop is open to all IPv6 addresses
Database is reachable from the internet
Database automated backups are turned off
Audit log files can be altered without detection
Audit trail records only one region
Access policy grants every action on every resource
Load balancer serves traffic over plain HTTP

gen-1-001-s3-public-acls-allowed.title: Storage bucket accepts public ACLs

requirement.text: Enforce approved authorizations for logical access to information and system resources.

newFindings.message: Ensure S3 bucket has block public ACLS enabled
Ensure that S3 bucket has a Public Access block
Public access block does not block public ACLs

gen-1-002-s3-encryption-removed.title: Storage bucket has no default encryption

requirement.text: Protect the confidentiality and integrity of information at rest.

newFindings.message: Ensure that S3 buckets are encrypted with KMS by default
Bucket does not encrypt data with a customer managed key.

gen-1-003-s3-versioning-suspended.title: Storage bucket versioning is suspended

requirement.text: Back up system-level and user-level information and protect the confidentiality and integrity of the backups.

newFindings.message: Ensure all data stored in the S3 bucket have versioning enabled
S3 Bucket Without Versioning
Bucket does not have versioning enabled

gen-1-004-sg-ssh-open-to-world.title: SSH is open to the whole internet

requirement.text: Monitor and control communications at the external boundary of the system and at key internal boundaries.

newFindings.message: Ensure no security groups allow ingress from 0.0.0.0:0 to port 22
Security Group With Unrestricted Access To SSH
Security group rule allows unrestricted ingress from any IP address.

gen-1-005-sg-rdp-open-ipv6.title: Remote desktop is open to all IPv6 addresses

requirement.text: Monitor and control communications at the external boundary of the system and at key internal boundaries.

newFindings.message: Ensure no security groups allow ingress from 0.0.0.0:0 to port 3389
Remote Desktop Port Open To Internet
Security group rule allows unrestricted ingress from any IP address.

gen-1-006-rds-unencrypted.title: Database storage is not encrypted

requirement.text: Protect the confidentiality and integrity of information at rest.

newFindings.message: Ensure all data stored in the RDS is securely encrypted at rest
DB Instance Storage Not Encrypted
Instance does not have storage encryption enabled.

gen-1-007-rds-public.title: Database is reachable from the internet

requirement.text: Monitor and control communications at the external boundary of the system and at key internal boundaries.

newFindings.message: Ensure all data stored in RDS is not publicly accessible
RDS DB Instance Publicly Accessible
Instance has Public Access enabled

gen-1-008-rds-no-backups.title: Database automated backups are turned off

requirement.text: Back up system-level and user-level information and protect the confidentiality and integrity of the backups.

newFindings.message: Ensure that RDS instances has backup policy
Instance has very low backup retention period.

gen-1-009-ebs-unencrypted.title: Disk volume is not encrypted

requirement.text: Protect the confidentiality and integrity of information at rest.

newFindings.message: Ensure all data stored in the EBS is securely encrypted
EBS Volume Encryption Disabled
EBS volume is not encrypted.

gen-1-010-kms-rotation-off.title: Encryption key is never rotated

requirement.text: Establish and manage cryptographic keys, including their rotation, when cryptography is used in the system.

newFindings.message: Ensure rotation for customer created CMKs is enabled
CMK Rotation Disabled
Key does not have rotation enabled.

gen-1-011-trail-validation-off.title: Audit log files can be altered without detection

requirement.text: Protect audit information from unauthorized access, modification and deletion.

newFindings.message: Ensure CloudTrail log file validation is enabled
Trail does not have log validation enabled.

gen-1-012-trail-single-region.title: Audit trail records only one region

requirement.text: Generate audit records for the defined auditable events across the system.

newFindings.message: Ensure CloudTrail is enabled in all Regions
Trail is not enabled across all regions.

gen-1-013-iam-wildcard-admin.title: Access policy grants every action on every resource

requirement.text: Allow only the access that users and processes need to accomplish their assigned tasks.

newFindings.message: Ensure IAM policies that allow full "*-*" administrative privileges are not created
Ensure IAM policies does not allow credentials exposure
Ensure IAM policies does not allow data exfiltration

Ensure IAM policies does not allow write access without constraints
Ensure AWS IAM policy does not allow full IAM privileges

requirement.text: Protect the confidentiality and integrity of transmitted information.

newFindings.message: Ensure ALB protocol is HTTPS
Ensure that load balancer is using at least TLS 1.2
